newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Turnpike announces reorg, personnel changes.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Turnpike announces reorg, personnel changes.

text.p: The New Jersey Turnpike Authority said Tuesday it made three personnel changes and reorganized two departments.

John Kunna, acting director of maintenance and engineering services, was named chief engineer. David Wingerter, the autority's assistant chief engineer in charge of maintenance, was named director or maintenance. And Randy Corman, a former state Senator, was named the authority's director of law.
In a separate move, the authority divided the Department of Maintenance and Engineering Services into two separate units.
The departments were merged more than two years ago at a time when there were no major new construction projects underway.

But recently, the authority "has been inundated with new, complex engineering projects on the drawing board," Edward Gross, executive director, said in a statement explaining the decision to redivide the units. "It is approprate to separate these two important functions so that they each may receive high level attention from dedicated directors."
